description: Family 3, pin-supported variant (docs/tasks.md section 4.6): the pinned lock rule, unbounded server capital, a common volume denominator, and no server-tier term. Corner parameters are those of the corner test in vendor/spiral/model/server.test.ts at the pinned commit; everything else is a bench decision.

provenance.many_bursty_long: given: corner('many-bursty') in model/server.test.ts (200 agents, 5000 sat in at p=0.02, 4000 sat out at p=0.01, horizon 8 lifetimes)
provenance.few_steady_recycling: given: corner('few-steady') in model/server.test.ts (3 agents, 100 + floor(10u) sat in and out every step, horizon 8 lifetimes)
provenance.many_bursty_correlated: invented: the first cell with 80% of burst indicators copied from a population-wide draw
provenance.always_channel_margin: given: margin 0.25 in the pinned corner test
provenance.always_vtxo_refresh_lead_blocks: given: refresh lead 288 in the pinned corner test and config/protocol.json (R5)
